section_eyebrow.llm_guidance: Short uppercase eyebrow, e.g. 'What we've learned'. Under 4 words. Optional.

section_title.llm_guidance: Section heading in one phrase. Under 9 words.

cards.llm_guidance: 4 to 8 insight cards, swiped/scrolled horizontally. Each: label (short uppercase tag, e.g. a topic or a real metric like '97% recovered'), headline (the insight in one bold line, max 12 words), body (one supporting sentence, max 22 words, optional), attribution (a real source/site if the insight is a claim, optional), link_url + link_label (optional). Only put a number in a label/headline if it is real and evidenced — never invent one.
